title: Corrupt audit line leaves readiness and liveness unchanged
operatorStep: On the staging host, while the ultrathink-web unit is running, append one line of non-JSON bytes to its audit log with `printf 'not-json\n' | sudo tee -a /var/lib/ultrathink/audit.jsonl > /dev/null`. If the staging unit sets ULTRATHINK_STATE_DIR, replace /var/lib/ultrathink with that absolute path; the audit file is always <stateDir>/audit.jsonl (services/ultrathink/obs/audit.ts auditPath).
notes: Expected behaviour is fail-open for audit: a corrupt line must not change /readyz or /healthz (routes/router.ts readyz around line 880 and the healthz handler around line 1099 do not read the audit log). The audit log is written only when ULTRATHINK_AUDIT_LOG is on, which is the default. If the file does not exist yet, the appended line creates it. The hypotheses observe HTTP status only; they do not check that audit verification (obs/audit-cli.ts) reports the corruption.

hypotheses.name: /readyz still returns 200 after the audit line is corrupt
/healthz still returns 200 after the audit line is corrupt
